title: Zindan Day Vich Ro Ro Sakina
body:
Zindan Day Vich Ro Ro Sakina Beemar Nu Bulaway
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaleya Qaid Di Kothi Vich (x2)
Darniyan Main Veeran, Kithay Shimmar Na Ajavey
<<DIVIDER>>
Ron Nai Dainda Menu Zalim Shimar Kameena
Kenda Chup Ker Ja Qaidan Ya, Tenu Aap Kerawan Sakina
Maar Tamachay Mou Tey, Zindan Dey Vich Menu
Kahin Vaar Daraway
<<DIVIDER>>
Laash Sakina Di Logon Sajjad Jadon Chai
Tak Khoon Kannan Chon Jaari, Baqar Yeh Deway Duai
Kis Haal Ich Keway Logon, Mera Baba Ujri Nu,
Haye Keeway Daffnaway
<<DIVIDER>>
Qaidi Bhain Dyan Tu, Sun Lay Veer Sadawan
Phupi Zainab Nu Vi Aakh Dewin, Gaiyan Mukh Hun Meriyan Sa’awan
Inna Qaidan Nay Abid, Menu Maar Mukhaya
Masooma Ay Kurlaway
<<DIVIDER>>
Sajjad Jadon Qaidan Mukh Jan Karbal Jaaven
Asghar Di Qabar Tey Ja Kay Tu, Hay Pani Us Tey Paawin Tu
Gal Gal Bhain Nu Tera, Enjh Paani Mangna
Din Raat Sattaway
